title: ReasoningResponse
description: Returned by Person 2's POST /reason (request: {graph: GraphData, fieldConfidence: FieldConfidence | null}). Everything the frontend needs in one call, so exploration and preset questions work with no further network requests. Call /reason again after any user correction.

highlight.description: Points the answer refers to, for focusing or highlighting in the UI.

caveats.description: Uncertainty to announce, e.g. unreadable values or low confidence.

text.description: Short spoken summary: graph type, variables, trend, key finding. Computed from the data; GraphData.summary is ignored.

compare.description: With one series, answers that there is nothing to compare.

series.description: One entry per series; each is explored independently.

intro.description: Spoken when the user switches to this series.

normalised.description: (value - min) / (max - min) over ALL series, so series share one pitch scale. 0.5 if every value is equal.

delta.description: Change from the previous point; null for the first point or when either value is missing.

changeStrength.description: |delta| / (max - min), capped at 1. 0 for the first point; null when either value is missing.

direction.description: Versus the previous point; moves under 2% of the value range are flat. 'flat' for the first point; 'unknown' when this or the previous value is missing.

isTurningPoint.description: The trend reverses here (peak or trough).

readout.description: Ready-to-speak, e.g. 'March, 12 degrees Celsius, up 5 from February.'

lowConfidence.description: graph.confidence or fieldConfidence.series below 0.6; numbers are then spoken as 'about ...'.

phrasing.description: Whether texts were reworded by Gemini (USE_LLM=1) or are the deterministic templates.
